visual_findings: Eleven red internal unit contacts and one red leftmost outer unit side are visible. Red does not leave the original grid, close a new region or split cells. All ten cells and the full18-unit silhouette remain clear.
group_targeting_validity_conciseness: Every internal marker is one distinct contact record with exactly two native owners; the outer marker supplies an actual1cm unit counterpart. Twelve fixed1pt overlays are sufficient for complete11-contact counting; no arbitrary mark cap is used. The incidence proof distinguishes one contact from two side occurrences.
old_objection_resolution: Native object IDs are numeric and cannot legally be style targets. The permitted add_line operation overlays exact existing full-precision controls, uses fixed1pt strokes and adds no new locus. Schema and IDs are unchanged; this is disclosed for parent review.
primary_math_unique: Exact native polygon-edge incidence yields10 squares,11 edges with two owners and18 exterior edges with one owner. Summing all40 side occurrences, each shared contact has contributed twice, so P=40-2*11=18cm. This is unique and can also be checked by traversing the complete outer silhouette. A single contact record is a physical one-unit segment but corresponds to two cell-side occurrences; subtracting once gives29. All red contact lines lie exactly on existing seams, and the one exterior exemplar is separately identified by its one-owner topology, not a new mathematical condition.
task_specific_human_semantics: Numerical perimeter of the same ten-square union. Thin fixed1pt red overlays coincide exactly with existing grid edges; they add no cells or cuts and retain the entire black exterior outline except the one actual exterior unit counterpart. Cells remain joined. Red contact lines are internal under the same incidence topology; color does not redefine the perimeter target.
